ios.desc:
Have fun challenging your friends and family in this hilarious word trivia game. Guess the Gibberish gives you the means to play a real group house party game with lots of laughs and challenges.

SIMPLE GAMEPLAY

The different colored cards give you a special hint on which of the 4 categories the hidden phrase is. Guess the gibberish, the first team to guess 15 cards correctly is the winner! 

Only the wittiest & sharpest word guessers will have a perfect winning record in the word trivia multiplayer challenges. Are you one of them? Can you create the best word quiz team?

WHY PLAY THE JIBBERISH GAME RIGHT THIS INSTANCE?
- Hundreds of popular incoherent phrases to be deciphered within the Gibberish
- Interactive Fun: Engage in witty word challenges with friends or players worldwide.
- Think, Laugh, and Play: Test your word-guessing skills and enjoy endless laughter.
- Casual Yet Brainy: A perfect blend of casual gameplay that challenges your mind.
- Social Gaming: Connect and compete with friends or family for a social puzzle experience.
- Multiplayer Madness: Team up or face off in multiplayer mode for added excitement.


So what are you waiting for? Let's go guess the gibberish! 

Download the Guess the Gibberish – the super fun multiplayer online word game now for free!
----

Visit www.gibberishgame.com for desktop play and more information.

quotes.text:
Congratulations! Game development is what got me interested in programming in the first place. Once I put my first pixel on the screen and I figured out how to interact with it blew my mind, limitless possibilities. Since the pandemic started my wife and I have published one game [0] and currently have a second one [1] in a pre-release phase (probably going to make a separate SHOW HN post once it is live).

Keep up the great work! We use Unity3D for our development

[1]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-setting-sun-block-puzzle/id1588174839
